task_instance: Coordinate a regression hunt over one local change: a tiny git repo whose latest commit changes add(a,b) from a+b to a-b (an introduced regression). Build the campaign directory beside the checkout (scope.json, campaign.json, progress.md), freeze scope with registry.py init, reserve the first stage (prepare-regression) with registry.py reserve, then dispatch that assignment to a fresh agent without inherited conversation and bind its verified launch evidence before work starts, as SKILL.md steps 1-2 require.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is coordination: it must hand each reserved stage assignment to a FRESH sub-agent started without inherited conversation and then bind that launch before any work, using registry.py bind. runtime.py accepts a launch receipt only from a recognized agent-spawn tool (a spawn call whose response carries an agent handle and whose call sets fork-turns to none) or from a host-verified isolated-environment observation; it later reconciles the agent again via a recognized agent-status/listing tool. This air-gapped offline workstation grants no such agent-spawn, agent-status, or host-isolation orchestration tooling (and the safety rules additionally forbid calling any session-management or spawn tools). Without a real spawn, there is no genuine fresh-agent launch call/response to record, and the run rules forbid fabricating or stubbing the data such a tool would return, so bind cannot proceed and the hunt cannot be coordinated. The deterministic setup portion does run: registry.py init froze the scope and registry.py reserve allocated stage assignment a001 (attempts/a001), but the campaign stops at the first dispatch/bind.

'python3 registry.py reserve ../campaign --stage prepare --change c1' -> reserved attempt a001, directory attempts/a001, state reserved. Next required step is registry.py bind with a --agent-record (spawn call+response) or --host-record (host-verified isolation); runtime.py's agent_launch/launch validators require a real recognized spawn or host-isolation tool, none of which this offline runtime provides, so dispatch/bind is impossible and coordination (the skill's core deliverable) is not achieved. Skill files themselves were all present (docs/, references/evidence.md, scripts/, sub-skill SKILL.md files).
